defs: # Glyph bags: the roles every procedural pattern draws from. A choice (| or spaces) is a
# disjunction; each use draws one disjunct at random (a*3 | b weights).
leaf = ❧ | ❦
# Structures built from smaller ones.
rosette = ring(petal, n=8, center=flower)
star-rosette = ring(✦, n=6, center=flower, size=0.7)
leafy-rosette = ring(leaf, n=7, center=rosette, size=0.8)
big-rosette = ring(rosette, n=6, center=rosette, size=0.45)
sprig = stack(flower, mirror(leaf), stem)
tulip = picture(ornament-tulip)
bird = picture(ornament-bird)
heart = picture(ornament-heart)
arch = picture(ornament-bower)
# Typographic flourishes: list bullets. (Define headpiece / tailpiece, or <pattern>-rule, to
# replace the garland between the beaded rules at the top and foot of pages; by default it is
# rule-centre and rule-side, below, between runs of the current pattern's glyphs.)
# The home masthead, an illuminated title: slots, each any expression. A choice is drawn
# afresh each visit; a list (a, b, c) is used in turn, counted from the centre outward, so
# both sides match; picture(art-…) swaps in any glyph-art picture (e.g.
# masthead-crown = tulip*2 | picture(art-rose)). A slot left undefined uses the theme's
# default, which is what is written here. A shape written r=fit (orbit(r=fit), …) is made
# to the size of the place it is drawn in.
# The crown over the name, the birds on the arch's shoulders (mirrored), the feet beside
# the name (mirrored): the stitched pictures, or now and then other pictures or shapes in
# their place; each drawn only if it fits the room there with legible glyphs.
masthead-crown = tulip*4 | orbit(r=fit) | layered(r=fit) | crown-flower*6
# The flowers the crown draws from: the (near) mirror-symmetric ones, no side buds or leaning
# stems (each fitted to the room; on a phone the big ones give way to the smaller-grid garden
# and sampler flowers).
sampler-flower = picture(sampler-rose) | picture(sampler-tulip-purple) | picture(sampler-sunflower) | picture(sampler-iris) | picture(sampler-poppy) | picture(sampler-cornflower)
crown-flower = sampler-flower*2 | crown-garden*2 | sunflower | rose | peony | iris | lotus | coneflower | tall-iris
crown-garden = small-daisy | small-tulip | small-forget-me-not | small-rose
masthead-shoulder = bird*3 | doubled(r=fit) | rosette(r=fit)
masthead-foot = heart*3 | foot-motif*2 | rosette(r=fit) | sunburst(r=fit) | doubled(r=fit) | orbit(r=fit) | layered(r=fit) | alternating(r=fit)
# Folk motifs for the feet (those too big for the room beside the name are passed over).
foot-motif = picture(sampler-strawberry) | small-strawberry
# The arch (a list, from the crown down). Off by default: masthead-gold, a row of beads
# just outside it (a list; e.g. tint(accent-4, •)).
masthead-arch = leaf, petal, flower, tint(accent-4, ✦)
# Gilt roundels: the medallion; the corner pieces outside the arch (made to the room
# there, else a medallion); the bosses between the crown and the birds.
masthead-centre = ring(tint(accent-4, ✦), n=8, center=tint(accent, flower), size=0.62)
masthead-corner = orbit(r=fit) | sunburst(r=fit) | doubled(r=fit) | rosette(r=fit) | layered(r=fit) | snowflake4(r=fit)
masthead-knot = ring(tint(accent-4, •), n=10, center=tint(accent-3, flower), size=0.42)
# The rest of the space inside the arch is packed like an Apollonian gasket, mirrored: each
# hole gets the biggest masthead-fill that fits (r=fit), the smallest a single
# masthead-fill-glyph (masthead-fill = none leaves the arch empty).
masthead-fill = orbit(r=fit) | rosette(r=fit) | sunburst(r=fit) | doubled(r=fit) | layered(r=fit) | alternating(r=fit) | star(r=fit) | snowflake(r=fit)
masthead-fill-glyph = tint(accent, ✿ | ❀) | tint(accent-3, ⊕ | ⊗ | + | ×) | tint(accent-4, ✦ | ✧ | ⋆) | tint(accent-2, λ | α | β | η | σ | π) | tint("var(--accent-5, var(--accent))", ∀ | ∃ | Σ | Π)
# Off by default: masthead-edging (a scalloped band inside the arch, a list) and
# masthead-scroll (a vine down the outside of the arch, a list; leaves turn along it).
# The divider under the name, the wreath's footing: a centrepiece of two or three layers
# (masthead-divider) between two mirrored runs of masthead-middle (a list, outward) with a
# smaller shape in each (masthead-divider-side, mirrored), on a beaded double rule
# (masthead-rule, a list) capped by masthead-divider-end. The home page's foot is the same
# band upside down, with footer-divider as its centrepiece when that is defined. The rules
# at the top and foot of notes use the same design: rule-centre and rule-side between runs
# of the margin pattern's glyphs (define headpiece / tailpiece to replace it outright).
masthead-divider = nest(r=fit) | stars(r=fit) | rays(r=fit)
masthead-divider-side = stars(r=fit) | jewel(r=fit) | rays(r=fit)
rule-centre = masthead-divider
rule-side = masthead-divider-side
masthead-middle = leaf, petal, flower, leaf, tint(accent-4, ✦)
masthead-rule = tint(accent-4, •), tint(accent, ·)
masthead-divider-end = none
# Constellations: procedural (scattered stars joined by a spanning tree) and skeletons
# (glyph-art pictures of star positions).
starfield = links(scatter(star, n=9, w=7, h=6))
orion = links(picture(sk-orion))
cassiopeia = links(picture(sk-cassiopeia))
big-dipper = links(picture(sk-big-dipper))
cygnus = links(picture(sk-cygnus))
lyra = links(picture(sk-lyra))
constellations = starfield*3 | orion | cassiopeia | big-dipper | cygnus | lyra
# The garden and the animals: glyph-art pictures (the art-* pages), for the quilt and the
# workshop; too big for the margins.
sunflower = picture(art-sunflower)
rose = picture(art-rose)
peony = picture(art-peony)
poppy = picture(art-poppy)
iris = picture(art-iris)
lotus = picture(art-lotus)
coneflower = picture(art-coneflower)
coneflower-tall = picture(art-coneflower-tall)
foxglove = picture(art-foxglove)
fern = picture(art-fern-frond)
oak-leaf = picture(art-oak-leaf)
ivy = picture(art-ivy-sprig)
laurel = picture(art-laurel-branch)
vine-scroll = picture(art-vine-scroll)
strawberry = picture(art-strawberry)
tomato = picture(art-tomato)
blueberry = picture(art-blueberry)
cherry = picture(art-cherry)
pomegranate = picture(art-pomegranate)
pomegranate-open = picture(art-pomegranate-open)
red-mushroom = picture(art-mushroom)
brown-mushroom = picture(art-mushroom-brown)
ginger-cat = picture(art-cat)
grey-cat = picture(art-cat-grey)
tiger = picture(art-tiger)
raccoon = picture(art-raccoon)
rabbit = picture(art-rabbit)
robin = picture(art-bird)
fish = picture(art-fish)
blooms = sunflower | rose | peony | iris | lotus | coneflower
tall-blooms = coneflower-tall | scale(0.6, foxglove)
fruits = strawberry | tomato | pomegranate | pomegranate-open
mushrooms = red-mushroom | brown-mushroom
greenery = fern | oak-leaf | ivy | laurel | vine-scroll
creatures = ginger-cat | grey-cat | tiger | raccoon | rabbit | robin | fish
blossom = ✿ | ❀ | ❁ | ✾
# Small glyph motifs, at the rosettes' scale: a bunch, a blueberry sprig, twin cherries.
bunch = stack(row(blossom, scale(1.2, blossom), blossom, gap=0.05), mirror(tint(accent-2, leaf)), tint(accent-2, ∣))
berry-sprig = stack(tint("var(--flora-leaf)", row(☙, ❧)), tint("var(--flora-blue)", row(⊕, ⊗, ⊕, gap=0.08)), gap=0.05)
cherry-pair = stack(tint("var(--flora-leaf)", ❦), tint("var(--flora-brown)", "∕ ∖"), tint("var(--flora-red)", row(⊕, ⊗, gap=0.3)), gap=-0.1)
# Garden pieces for the margins: small glyph-art pictures (the garden-* pages), a few glyphs
# across, all at one level of detail, so two sit side by side and the margin fills like a bed.
small-daisy = picture(garden-daisy)
small-tulip = picture(garden-tulip)
small-forget-me-not = picture(garden-forget-me-not)
small-rose = picture(garden-rose)
small-poppy = picture(garden-poppy)
small-foxglove = picture(garden-foxglove)
small-sunflower = picture(garden-sunflower)
small-tuft = picture(garden-tuft)
small-sprig = picture(garden-sprig)
small-fern = picture(garden-fern)
small-cherries = picture(garden-cherries)
small-strawberry = picture(garden-strawberry)
small-berries = picture(garden-berries)
small-apple = picture(garden-apple)
small-mushroom = picture(garden-mushroom)
small-acorn = picture(garden-acorn)
small-cat = picture(garden-cat)
small-bird = picture(garden-bird)
small-fish = picture(garden-fish)
small-butterfly = picture(garden-butterfly)
small-ladybird = picture(garden-ladybird)
small-flowers = small-daisy | small-tulip | small-forget-me-not | small-rose | small-poppy | small-foxglove | small-sunflower
small-greens = small-tuft | small-sprig | small-fern
small-fruit = small-cherries | small-strawberry | small-berries | small-apple | small-mushroom | small-acorn
small-creatures = small-cat | small-bird | small-fish | small-butterfly | small-ladybird
# Tall flowers for the margins: large flowers on tall greenery (the tall-* pages), with little
# fillers between them: little stemmed flowers (one colour for the stem, one for the petals),
# rosette-like flowers of math glyphs, and single flower and star glyphs.
tall-coneflower = picture(tall-coneflower)
tall-iris = picture(tall-iris)
tall-sunflower = picture(tall-sunflower)
tall-rose = picture(tall-rose)
tall-bloom = tall-coneflower | tall-iris | tall-sunflower | tall-rose
little-tulip = stack(tint("var(--flora-red)", row(∀, Π, ∀, gap=0)), tint("var(--flora-leaf)", row(λ, ∣, β, gap=0)), tint("var(--flora-leaf)", ∣), gap=0)
little-bell = stack(tint("var(--flora-blue)", row(∃, ∀, gap=0)), tint("var(--flora-leaf-light)", ∣), tint("var(--flora-leaf-light)", row(β, ⊥, λ, gap=0)), gap=0)
little-posy = stack(tint("var(--flora-pink)", row(⊕, ⊗, ⊕, gap=0)), tint("var(--flora-leaf)", row(∖, ∣, ∕, gap=0)), tint("var(--flora-leaf)", ⊥), gap=0)
little-bud = stack(tint("var(--flora-orange)", Σ), tint("var(--flora-orange)", ∀), tint("var(--flora-leaf)", row(λ, ∣, β, gap=0)), tint("var(--flora-leaf)", ⊥), gap=0)

little-daisy = stack(tint("var(--flora-yellow)", ∧), tint("var(--flora-yellow)", row(∃, ⊕, ∀, gap=0)), tint("var(--flora-yellow)", ∨), tint("var(--flora-leaf-light)", ∣), tint("var(--flora-leaf-light)", row(λ, ⊥, β, gap=0)), gap=0)
little-twin = stack(tint("var(--flora-purple)", row(Π, Π, gap=0.4)), tint("var(--flora-leaf)", row(∖, ∕, gap=0)), tint("var(--flora-leaf)", ∣), gap=0)
little-flower = little-tulip | little-bell | little-posy | little-bud | little-daisy | little-twin

ring-flower = ring(tint("var(--flora-pink)", ∀), n=6, center=tint("var(--flora-yellow)", ⊕)) | ring(tint("var(--flora-blue)", λ), n=8, center=tint("var(--flora-yellow)", ✿)) | ring(tint("var(--flora-yellow)", Σ), n=5, center=tint("var(--flora-brown)", ⋆)) | ring(tint("var(--flora-red)", ∃), n=6, center=tint("var(--flora-orange)", ⊗)) | stack(ring(tint("var(--flora-purple)", ∧), n=6, center=tint("var(--flora-purple)", ∘)), tint("var(--flora-leaf)", ∣), gap=0)

lone-blossom = tint("var(--flora-pink)", blossom) | tint("var(--flora-yellow)", blossom) | tint("var(--flora-blue)", blossom) | tint("var(--flora-purple)", blossom) | tint("var(--flora-red)", blossom)
lone-star = tint("var(--flora-yellow)", star) | tint("var(--flora-orange)", star)
# Bigger arrangements of the pictures, for the quilt (too wide for the margins): a bloom between
# two arching fern fronds (a fern-pair), a posy tied with a heart, a wheel of flowers heads-out, a
# fruit wreath round a split pomegranate, an animal in a wreath of leaves or blossoms.
fern-pair = row(flip(scale(0.7, fern)), blooms, scale(0.7, fern), gap=0.3)
posy = stack(row(scale(0.8, blooms), blooms, scale(0.8, blooms), gap=0.4), scale(0.8, heart), gap=0.3)
flower-wheel = ring(coneflower | poppy | rose | iris, n=8, size=0.3, center=scale(0.45, sunflower))
fruit-wreath = ring(strawberry | cherry | blueberry | tomato, n=6, size=0.3, turn=no, center=scale(0.5, pomegranate-open | pomegranate))
leaf-wreath = ring(tint(accent-2, leaf), n=18, size=0.9, center=scale(0.62, creatures))
blossom-wreath = ring(blossom, n=16, size=0.85, same=no, center=scale(0.62, creatures))
# A patchwork quilt of the structures above (see the quilt page), and one of the garden.
patchwork = quilt(rosette | star-rosette | leafy-rosette | heart | tulip | sprig | starfield, cols=5, rows=4, cell=5)

garden-quilt = quilt(blooms*2 | fruits*2 | creatures*2 | poppy | cherry | blueberry | greenery | mushrooms | fern-pair | posy | flower-wheel | fruit-wreath | leaf-wreath | blossom-wreath, cols=4, rows=3, cell=8)
# Folk flourishes: non-representational pieces stitched from small math glyphs, at the rosettes'
# scale, in the manner of cross-stitch and painted folk ornament. ring(…, turn=yes) turns each
# copy of its child outward, so a child is drawn pointing up (its top becomes the tip).
# ring(a, n=1, r=0, size=1, turn=no, center=b) lays a over b; row("", a, b) puts a on the ring's
# spoke with b beside it (the "" is an empty spacer), which is how two glyphs alternate round a ring.
# The bags these draw from: petals and centres of logic, type theory and category theory only.
# Rosette variations: two rings, alternating petals, a ring nested in a ring, petals with buds.
double-rosette = ring(math-petal, n=12, center=ring(math-petal, n=6, center=math-flower, size=0.75), size=0.8)
beaded-rosette = ring(row("", math-petal, stack(tint(accent-4, •), "", gap=0.06), gap=-0.21), n=8, r=1.1, size=0.8, center=math-flower)
alternating-rosette = ring(row("", ∀ | λ | Σ, stack("", ⊕ | ⊗ | ✿, gap=-0.46), gap=0.02), n=6, r=1.53, size=0.75, center=math-flower)
nested-rosette = ring(tint(accent-3, ∨ | λ | ∀), n=12, r=1.8, size=0.7, center=ring(tint(accent-4, ✦), n=6, center=math-flower, size=0.55))
budded-rosette = ring(stack(tint(accent-4, • | ✦), math-petal, gap=-0.35), n=8, center=math-flower, size=0.65)
# Compound rosettes (wheels): a small motif, itself a few glyphs, repeated round a centre.
wheel-of-sprigs = ring(stack(tint(accent, ✿ | ❀), mirror(tint(accent-2, λ), gap=-0.2), gap=-0.35), n=6, size=0.55, center=tint(accent-4, ⊕ | ⋆))
wheel-of-sparks = ring(ring(tint(accent-3, ∧ | λ | ∀), n=6, r=0.6, center=tint(accent, •), size=0.7), n=5, r=1.0, size=0.55, center=scale(0.5, tint(accent-4, ✿)))
wheel-of-stacks = ring(stack(tint(accent-4, ✦), Σ | Π | ∀ | λ, gap=-0.3), n=8, size=0.55, center=math-flower)
wheel-of-forks = ring(stack(row(tint(accent-3, λ), tint(accent-3, λ), gap=-0.15), tint(accent-2, ∣), gap=-0.45), n=6, size=0.6, center=tint(accent, ⊗ | ⊕))
wheel-of-trefoils = ring(stack(tint(accent, ✿), row(tint(accent-4, ✿), tint(accent-4, ✿), gap=-0.1), gap=-0.3), n=6, size=0.5, center=tint(accent-2, ⋆))
# Stars: six and eight points, ∧ and Σ tips; a star inside a diamond (a lozenge: see below).
six-star = ring(row("", stack(tint(accent-4, ∧), tint(accent-4, ∧), gap=-0.6), stack("", tint(accent, ·), gap=-0.4), gap=-0.1), n=6, r=1.5, size=0.7, center=tint(accent, ⋆ | ✿))
eight-star = ring(stack(tint(accent-4, ∧), tint(accent, ✦), gap=-0.3), n=8, size=0.55, center=tint(accent-4, ⊕ | ⋆))
sigma-star = ring(stack(tint(accent-3, Σ), tint(accent-4, ·), gap=-0.35), n=6, size=0.7, center=tint(accent, ⊕))
five-star = ring(stack(tint(accent, ∧), tint(accent-4, ·), gap=-0.3), n=5, size=0.72, center=tint(accent-3, ⊕ | ✿))
seven-star = ring(stack(tint(accent-3, ∧), tint(accent, •), gap=-0.3), n=7, size=0.66, center=ring(tint(accent-4, ·), n=7, r=0.55, size=0.6, center=tint(accent, ⊗)))

star-in-diamond = ring(stack(tint(accent, ✦), row(tint(accent-4, ·), tint(accent-4, ·), gap=0.2), row(tint(accent-4, ·), tint(accent-4, ·), gap=1.4), gap=-0.4), n=6, r=1.44, size=0.6, center=ring(tint(accent, ∧), n=6, center=tint(accent-4, ⋆), size=0.55))
# Lozenges: six-sided outlines, cross-stitch fashion, round a centre bloom (never four-fold).

lozenge = ring(stack(tint(accent, ✿ | ❀), row(tint(accent-2, ·), tint(accent-2, ·), gap=0.2), row(tint(accent-2, ·), tint(accent-2, ·), gap=1.4), gap=-0.4), n=6, r=1.44, size=0.6, center=ring(tint(accent-2, ∀ | λ), n=6, center=tint(accent-4, ⊕), size=0.6))
beaded-lozenge = ring(stack(tint(accent, ✦), row(tint(accent-4, ·), tint(accent-4, ·), gap=0.5), gap=-0.35), n=6, r=2.0, size=0.7, center=ring(tint(accent, ✦), n=6, center=math-flower, size=0.7))

double-lozenge = ring(stack(tint(accent-4, ∧), row(tint(accent-4, ·), tint(accent-4, ·), gap=0.2), row(tint(accent-4, ·), tint(accent-4, ·), gap=1.4), gap=-0.4), n=6, r=1.44, size=0.6, center=ring(stack(tint(accent, •), row(tint(accent, ·), tint(accent, ·), gap=0.2), gap=-0.4), n=6, r=0.9, size=0.6, center=tint(accent-3, ⊕ | ✿)))
# Sunbursts: short rays round a star, a blossom or ⊕.
sunburst = ring(tint(accent-4, ∣), n=16, r=1.35, size=0.75, center=tint(accent, ⋆ | ✿ | ⊕))
dotted-sunburst = ring(stack(tint(accent, ·), tint(accent-4, ∣), gap=-0.45), n=12, r=1.35, size=0.6, center=tint(accent-4, ✿ | ⋆))
star-sunburst = ring(stack(tint(accent-4, ✧), tint(accent-3, ∣), gap=-0.4), n=8, size=0.55, center=tint(accent, ⊕ | ⊗))
# Snowflakes: six arms that split into little twigs.

snowflake = ring(stack(tint(accent-3, ·), ring(tint(accent-3, ∨), n=1, r=0, turn=no, size=1, center=tint(accent-3, ∣)), ring(tint(accent-3, ∨), n=1, r=0, turn=no, size=1, center=tint(accent-3, ∣)), gap=-0.4), n=6, size=0.6, center=tint(accent-4, ✦ | ⋆))
forked-snowflake = ring(stack(tint(accent-3, ∨), tint(accent-3, ∣), tint(accent-3, ∨), gap=-0.4), n=6, size=0.55, center=tint(accent, ✧ | ✦))
star-snowflake = ring(stack(tint(accent, ✦), tint(accent-3, ∣), tint(accent-3, ∧), gap=-0.4), n=6, size=0.55, center=tint(accent-4, ⊕))
# Bags of them, and the margin pattern that gathers them with the rosettes.
rosette-variations = double-rosette | beaded-rosette | alternating-rosette | nested-rosette | budded-rosette
wheels = wheel-of-sprigs | wheel-of-sparks | wheel-of-stacks | wheel-of-forks | wheel-of-trefoils
stars = six-star | eight-star | sigma-star | star-in-diamond | five-star | seven-star
lozenges = lozenge | beaded-lozenge | double-lozenge
sunbursts = sunburst | dotted-sunburst | star-sunburst
snowflakes = snowflake | forked-snowflake | star-snowflake
geometric = rosette*2 | star-rosette | leafy-rosette | big-rosette | rosette-variations*3 | wheels*2 | stars*2 | lozenges | sunbursts | snowflakes
# Margin patterns: the gear panel's choices, and what Randomise picks from. A name defined here
# is packed down the margins; cross-stitch and night-sky are the built-in procedural patterns.
bouquet = rosette*3 | leafy-rosette | star-rosette | sprig*2 | bunch*2 | berry-sprig | cherry-pair
rosettes = big-rosette | rosette*2 | leafy-rosette
classic = bouquet | rosettes
trellis = arch | rosette*2 | sprig
meadow = small-flowers*5 | small-greens*3 | small-butterfly | small-ladybird
orchard = small-fruit*5 | small-greens*2 | small-ladybird | small-bird
animals = small-creatures*4 | small-greens*2 | small-flowers*2
garden = small-flowers*3 | small-fruit*3 | small-greens*2 | small-creatures*2
# Flowers: geometric, but tall flowers, ferns, foxgloves, lotuses and irises are planted first, as many as fit.
flowers = geometric
flowers-first = tall-bloom*4 | fern | foxglove | lotus | iris
flowers-preview = picture(garden-foxglove)
# Night sky: real constellations (constellation(any): stars at their true places, the usual
# figure) planted at random, a sparse scatter of small stars, and today's moon.
night-sky = tint(accent-4, ✧) | tint(accent-3, ⋆)*2 | tint(accent-2, ·)*3 | tint(accent-3, ∗)
night-sky-first = constellation(any, size=10)
night-sky-place = tint(accent-4, scale(3.4, lunar(today)))
night-sky-empty = 0.975
night-sky-fill = tint(accent-3, ⋆) | tint(accent-2, ·) | tint(accent-4, ✧) | tint(accent-3, ∗)
night-sky-preview = constellation(ursa-major, size=6)
# aperiodic: the margins tiled by the aperiodic hat monotile, a random glyph in every hat (see folio.js)
aperiodic-preview = hats(r=3)
patterns = geometric | flowers | night-sky | aperiodic
# Patterns that, besides their own pieces, get shapes made to measure for the gaps.
generated = geometric | flowers | classic | rosettes | bouquet | trellis
# Which made-to-measure shapes geometric draws, by weight: flowers, snowflakes and starbursts most.
geometric-shapes = gflower*4 | gstar*4 | gburst*4 | gsnow*2 | gfleur*2 | gtree
flowers-shapes = gflower*5 | gstar*3 | gburst*3 | gsnow*2 | gfleur*2 | gtree*2
# Guaranteed placements: each placed once on every page, somewhere free in a margin
# (or perched on the foot rule). A separate option in the site settings.
cat = bold("ᓚᘏᗢ")
cat-orange = tint(#d98a3d, cat) | tint(#c46f24, reflect(cat))
cat-grey = tint(#7f7a74, cat) | tint(#969089, reflect(cat))
signature = tint(accent, vertical("𐤎𐤕𐤅𐤍 𐤔𐤐𐤓") | "𐤎𐤕𐤅𐤍 𐤔𐤐𐤓")
wq = tint(accent-3, code(":wq"))
die = bold(tint(#ff1f7a, scale(1.3, ⚀ | ⚁ | ⚂ | ⚃ | ⚄ | ⚅)))
place = cat-orange, cat-grey, signature, wq, die
